title: Scalar halos and conical matching for finite-width vortices at a wormhole throat
summary: We study the static matter constraint associated with a conical deficit that varies along a string near a wormhole throat. A positive scalar-dependent factor multiplying the complete Abelian-Higgs Lagrangian couples a finite-width vortex to a canonical kink. At critical coupling, we obtain the leading longitudinally varying vortex tension. The flat-kink fluctuation operator has an even translational mode and an odd shape mode of mass $\sqrt{3}/L_χ$.
